name: Terror Con
blurb: New England's horror convention at the Royal Plaza Trade Center in Marlborough, with horror celebrities, artists, rock acts and pro wrestlers.
notes: No dedicated convention website; it is run by Altered Reality Entertainment (same organizer as Rhode Island Comic Con/Anime Con) and only has a venue placeholder on ricomiccon.com/upcoming-events ('TERROR CON MASSACHUSETTS DATES TBA / ROYAL PLAZA TRADE CENTER / 181 ROYAL PLAZA DRIVE-WEST / MARLBOROUGH, MASSACHUSETTS 01752'), so the Instagram page (bio link routes to linktr.ee/alteredrealityentertainment) is used as url per the no-website special case. That Instagram bio says the show 'returns in 2027', confirming it skipped 2025/2026 and has no 2026-10-05..2027-12-31 dates announced yet, hence editions: []. Last confirmed run found (via HorrorCons.com) was Terror Con 2024, Sept 27-29, 2024 at the same venue; no evidence of a 2025 edition. Guests and a 2027 lineup are not yet announced anywhere official.
